scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: How about a social networking app where we can all share travel spots? Lab members could post photos and impressions of the places they visited, and we could exchange info with each other.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Wow! That’s a really great idea♪

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: I always take tons of pictures when I travel, but I don’t really get to show them to anyone... With this app, I could actually make use of those experiences!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Yes! Megumi’s genuinely excited about it. This could really turn into a fun project we build together.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: As expected of you, {{playerName}}-senpai! Now I’m really looking forward to presenting this at the lab trip♪

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Alright then, let’s talk about the specific features and design. I’d love to hear your ideas too, Megumi.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Yes! Let’s give it our best♪ Oh, but it’s getting late today, so how about we officially start tomorrow?

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: And so, the joint development project between {{playerName}} and Megumi began. It seemed like the two of them were growing closer already...

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: By the way, {{playerName}}-senpai... I’m a beginner at programming. Where should I even start?

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: What advice would you give to beginner programmer Megumi?

options.text: Just have Claude Code write it for you
Let’s define the requirements thoroughly and then build it
Start by copying programming syntax by hand to learn the basics
